name: Hammerblaze
review:
A forge-and-fire game on a 7x7 cluster grid with avalanches, exploding wilds and a multiplier grid. Spots that keep winning get hotter.

On a grid this size, long avalanche chains are what push wins towards the 10,000x cap. Very high volatility, so a lot of spins fizzle. The published RTP is 94.13%, lower than average. Try it in demo before committing real money.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
